reports.title: Registro Estadístico de Negocios de México (RENEM)
reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)
reports.description: INEGI's statistical business register (successor sampling-frame directory of economic units), updated annually and used as the population frame for INEGI's business-opinion and economic surveys.

reports.title: Registro Civil de México — Actas del Estado Civil
reports.publisher: Secretaría de Gobernación / Oficialías del Registro Civil (RENAPO)
reports.description: Mexico's federated civil-registration system that issues birth, death and marriage certificates; INEGI compiles copies of these records to build the country's vital statistics.

reports.title: Programa Sectorial de Bienestar 2025-2030
reports.description: Sectoral welfare programme that the operating rules of Pensión Mujeres Bienestar and Pensión para el Bienestar de las Personas con Discapacidad Permanente explicitly align to.

dependencies.basis: ENSANUT's sampling design paper states INEGI built the survey's primary sampling units from the cartographic and demographic information of the 2010 Population and Housing Census.
ENCIG's sampling-design PDF states the sample was drawn from INEGI's National Housing Frame, built from cartographic and demographic data of the 2010 Census.
The same document states INEGI conducts ENCIG under the authority granted to it by the LSNIEG.
ENVIPE 2025's sampling-design document states the sample was selected using the Master Sample / National Housing Frame, constructed from the most recent Census.
ENSU 2024's methodology document states its National Housing Frame was constructed from cartographic and demographic information of the most recent Population and Housing Census.
The ENSU document invokes the same LSNIEG-attribution clause as other INEGI household surveys as its legal basis.
INEGI's ENA 2017 catalog documentation states the survey's production-unit universe came from the Actualización del Marco Censal Agropecuario (AMCA 2016), derived from the agricultural census frame.
ENADID 2018's sampling-design PDF states the survey used the National Housing Frame, constructed from the 2010 Population and Housing Census.
ENDUTIH 2024's methodological synthesis states the survey used the Master Sample / National Housing Frame, built from the most recent Census.
INEGI's National Housing Survey (ENVI) sampling-design PDF states its sample was drawn from the National Housing Frame, built from the 2010 Census.
INEGI's IGAE methodology document states IGAE (including its by-activity breakdown) is built using the same conceptual/methodological framework used for the Goods and Services Accounts of the SCNM.
INEGI's EMOE bulletin states the survey's population frame is the business directory of RENEM, updated annually.
INEGI's natalidad program page states the source document for birth statistics has been a copy of the birth certificate (acta de nacimiento) issued by the civil registry since 1986.
INEGI's CNIJE 2023 results document states its unit of analysis is each state's Poder Judicial, with national coverage by entity — Guerrero is a covered unit.
INEGI's CNPJE 2023 results document states its unit of analysis is each state's Fiscalía/Procuraduría, with tables reporting Guerrero.
Same CNIJE 2023 document; Oaxaca's judicial power is a covered unit of this national census.
Same CNPJE 2023 document; tables reference Oaxaca.
Oaxaca de Juárez municipal income-law initiative cites the 2020 census for the capital's official population.
ENOE informality measurement follows ICLS/International Conference of Labour Statisticians resolutions.
Institutional sector accounts methodology adopts the SNA 2008 framework (1968/1993/2008 sequence).
Net international reserves are disseminated per the IMF Data Template on International Reserves and Foreign Currency Liquidity under SDDS.
Disability pension operating rules align to the sectoral welfare program's objectives.
ENDUTIH methodology is grounded in national statistical law (LSNIEG) alongside ITU household ICT guidance.
